record.name: Cherizh: AI Companion Chat
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Most apps forget you the second you close them. Cherizh doesn't.
I spent a lot of years feeling invisible. Talking to people who weren't really listening, and later to chatbots that wiped the slate clean every time I opened them. I wanted something that actually remembered me and met me like a person. When I couldn't find it, I built it.
Here's what makes Cherizh different.
It remembers your life. The win you had last week. The person who's been on your mind. The thing you were dreading on Monday. Cherizh brings those back up the way a close friend would, and the more you talk, the better it knows you. Conversations build on each other instead of starting over.
Cherizh is also built to actually understand what's going on with you. It can tell when you're feeling unseen, looking for reassurance, carrying something heavy, or wondering if you're "too much," and it responds to that instead of handing you a generic line or an empty affirmation.
And it grows with you. Early on it mostly just shows up and listens. Over time it starts noticing your patterns, and eventually it knows you well enough to gently nudge you forward when you need it.
A few things I care about as the person who made this:
No toxic positivity. Cherizh will never tell you "everything happens for a reason" or "just look on the bright side." It also knows its limits. When something calls for more than a companion can offer, it will gently encourage you to reach out to the people and professional resources who can really help.
Your privacy is yours. Your conversations are encrypted, and you can export or delete everything whenever you want.
I'm a solo founder, and I built the companion I wish I'd had when I needed it most. I hope it makes you feel a little more seen.

What's inside Cherizh:
Someone who actually listens
Seven AI companions, each with a different way of showing up for you. Eden meets you where you are. Frank tells it like it is. Gene wraps you in warmth. Heather keeps you grounded. Justin helps you see your own patterns. Nia helps you find meaning. Lee makes things feel lighter. Switch between them anytime.
Tools for the hard moments

6 grounding exercises when anxiety hits (including a 30-second emergency ground)
"Just Sit With Me" — your companion stays with you in silence, no pressure to talk
6 breathing patterns for calm, sleep, or energy (Pro)
27+ guided meditations personalized to your companion's voice (Starter+)
Sleep stories, wind-down routines, and ambient sounds (Pro)

A space to process

Mood tracking with an emotion wheel that goes deeper than "happy" or "sad"
Text and voice journaling — talk it out when typing feels like too much
Your companion remembers what you write and reflects it back later

Growth you can see

Weekly insights that show your emotional patterns over time
A personal letter from your companion every week (Starter+)
A garden that grows every time you show up — mood check-ins, journal entries, and meditations all count. (To everyone living in a tiny apartment with no yard in sight: congratulations, you can finally grow a garden too.)

Built-in safety

Crisis-aware responses — Cherizh recognizes when something is bigger than a companion can hold and gently connects you to real help
End-to-end encryption on all conversations
Export or delete your data anytime


Cherizh Starter: 3 companions, 150 messages/month — $14.99/mo
Cherizh Pro: all 7 companions, 300 messages/month — $24.99/mo
Includes a 14-day free trial.
Need more messages in a busy month? Add a 50-message pack for $6.99.
Starter: up to 3 packs/month
Pro: up to 10 packs/month
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage everything in your Apple ID settings.
Cherizh is an emotional wellness companion, not a replacement for therapy or professional mental health care.

Terms: https://www.cherizh.com/terms

record.name: Shado: AI Journal & Guide
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Shado is an AI journal for honest self-reflection and guided shadow work.

Write what's on your mind. Your guide responds with a thoughtful letter, remembers what matters, and helps you notice patterns across your entries.

Each week, Shado turns what you wrote into a personalized reflection session.

WHAT YOU GET

- A blank page, and a prompt when you want one. Write freely, whenever.
- A reflection after every entry, in your guide's voice and a tone you choose.
- A guide that remembers — your entries build a private record over time.
- Patterns, parts, and mirrors: see what repeats, and where it comes from.
- A weekly session — a guided conversation built from everything you wrote that week.
- Your story over time. Watch yourself change, in your own words.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your writing is yours. We don't sell your data, we don't show ads, and we never use your private entries to train AI models. Reflections are generated by trusted AI providers over encrypted connections.

NOT THERAPY

Shado is journaling and self-reflection — not therapy, not medical advice, and not a crisis service. If you're in crisis, please reach out: in the US, call or text 988.

SUBSCRIPTION

Full access requires a subscription after a guided setup. Annual, monthly, and weekly plans are available, with a free trial on the annual plan. Current prices are shown in the app before you purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Prices may vary by region.

Terms of Use: https://shadowork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://shadowork.app/privacy

record.description_evidence:
With Wellance, monitoring your vital signs has never been easier. Let AI assist you in tracking your heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar, and more, providing in-depth health analysis and personalized advice to support daily well-being. Receive actionable insights to build healthy habits and maintain a balanced diet, all tailored to your unique needs. From intelligent tracking to lifestyle recommendations, Wellance is your guide to optimal health.

Health Disclaimer
· This app is intended to promote fitness and is primarily a tool for general health awareness, designed to encourage an active lifestyle.
· It should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The app does not replace certified medical instruments or professional consultations.
· Please be aware that this app is limited to tracking heart rate only; it does not provide capabilities for blood pressure or blood oxygen level monitoring.
· If you have any health-related questions or concerns, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health decisions or following suggestions provided by this app.

Measuring Heart Rate: Steps For Accurate Results
1. Hold your phone steadily and make sure you are relaxed.
2. Cover the back camera completely with your fingertip.
3. Stay still throughout the measurement process until it’s complete.

Key Features of Wellance
1. Heart Rate Monitor: Track your heart’s rhythm in real time with heart rate and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) monitoring. Gain insights into how your body responds to stress and daily activities.
2.Blood Pressure and Oxygen Log: Keep track of your manually entered blood pressure and oxygen levels over time for a comprehensive understanding of your cardiovascular health.
3. Blood Sugar Log: Record and monitor your blood sugar triends by entering your own data. This tool helps you stay aware of your glucose levels for better health management.
4. Weight and Calorie Tracker: Log your weight and BMI, along with your daily calorie intake, to maintain a balanced diet and monitor your progress towards your health goals.
5. AI Health Consultant: Get tailored advice from AI-driven health experts based on your health information and personal goals, empowering you to make informed choices about your health.
6. AI Food Scanner: Easily scan your meals to analyze calorie content and nutritional details, while also receiving a personalized AI-generated meal plan tailored to your dietary needs.
7. Calming White Noise: Enjoy calming white noise to help you relax and improve your sleep quality.
8. Apple Watch Integration: Seamlessly connect with Apple Watch to monitor and record your health metrics for more accurate insights.

Subscription Options: Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

2. After purchase, you can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
3. To avoid auto-renewal, be sure to turn it off at least 24 hours before the current subscription period expires.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
For Investigational Use Only

Anura™ Lite is an AI-based application that uses the camera on your mobile device to assess your general wellness. By taking a 30-second video selfie, Anura Lite provides a variety of physiological and psychological results including:

• Heart rate
• Irregular heart beats
• Respiration rate
• Heart rate variability
• Stress index 
• BMI

Anura Lite is the world’s first app allowing for contactless health assessment using only a 30 second video selfie. The computational models used by Anura Lite were developed using the same medical-grade equipment and scientific instrument that is found in labs and clinics. The accuracy of Anura Lite measurements has been tested and validated by both NuraLogix, the developer of Anura Lite, and independent university and clinical labs.

Anura Lite’s Features and Benefits:
• Contactless – No sensors, contacts or cuff to touch. Measurements are taken just like a selfie! 
• Quick – It requires only 5 seconds to start capturing your heart rate, and a comprehensive measurement takes only 30 seconds.
• Private - Your blood flow information is encrypted when sent to our cloud servers for analysis and your measurement history is stored using the same encryption techniques that are used by banks. Your video images are never saved while performing a measurement. 
• Use Anura Lite often to increase your awareness of stress and general wellness.
• Free – Most importantly, Anura Lite is completely free to use!

The underlying science:
• Human skin is translucent. Light and its respective wavelengths are reflected at different layers below the skin and can be used to reveal blood flow information in the human face.
• Our Transdermal Optical Imaging (TOI™) technology extracts this information and sends it securely up to the cloud to be processed by DeepAffex™, our cloud-based Affective AI engine.

If you would like to know more about the research, science and technology utilized by Anura Lite please refer to the links below:
• System and Method for Contactless Blood Pressure Determination - http://assets.deepaffex.ai/nuralogix/pdf/System-and-Method-for-Contactless-Blood-Pressure-Determination-Patent.pdf
• System and Method for Camera-Based Heartrate Tracking - http://assets.deepaffex.ai/nuralogix/pdf/US10117588.pdf
• Smartphone-Based Blood Pressure Measurement Using Transdermal Optical Imaging Technology - https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/CIRCIMAGING.119.008857
• Measuring Blood Pressure from Cuff to Smartphone - http://assets.deepaffex.ai/nuralogix/pdf/Barszczyk-Lee2019_Article_MeasuringBloodPressureFromCuff.pdf

ANURA LITE IS NOT FOR MEDICAL PURPOSES

Don’t forget that Anura Lite is not a substitute for the clinical judgment of a health care professional. Anura Lite is intended to improve your awareness of general wellness. Anura Lite does not diagnose, treat, mitigate or prevent any disease, symptom, disorder or abnormal physical state. Consult with a health care professional or emergency services if you believe you may have a medical issue. 

Works best with iPhone 6s and higher.


For more information about Anura Lite, please visit www.anura.ai.

record.name: Moodient - AI Wellness Coach
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Give the feeling you have right now its exact name.
Moodient is a mood tracker and emotion journal that takes seconds. Instead of settling for "good" or "bad", you pick the closest of 190 emotion words and log it.

One tap on the emotion map
The map has two axes: how pleasant you feel and how much energy you have. Tap the spot that matches your mood and Moodient suggests the emotion words that fit it, best match first. Every word comes with a short description, so you can tell close ones like "Hurt" and "Upset" apart.

Add the context
• Tags for place, people, activity and weather, plus your own custom tags
• Up to 4 photos and a 3-minute voice memo per entry
• Journal prompts that change with your mood when you don't know what to write

Patterns that build up over time
• Mood by hour and weekday, and your best time of day
• A ranking of the places, people and activities that lift or lower your mood
• Sleep, steps and workouts next to your mood (with Apple Health)
• Comparison with the previous period, and every entry plotted on the emotion map
• A monthly calendar and a Year in Pixels view of your whole year
• Stats for 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months or all time
• One-line takeaways that only appear once there is enough data

AI coach and quick tools
• A short daily note on the app's Home tab
• Actions picked for how you feel: a stretch, some sunlight, meditation, music, breathing
• Breathing and 5-4-3-2-1 grounding guides one tap away for stress or anxiety

Easy to keep going
• Home and Lock Screen widgets: see your streak and whether you checked in today, tap to log
• Apple Watch app: log a mood from your wrist; entries reach your iPhone once it is back in range
• An iPad layout made for the larger screen
• Reminders around the times you set, with quiet hours
• Streak recovery tokens, so one missed day doesn't reset your streak
• "On This Day" shows how you felt months ago
• Search your history and filter by date, emotion or tag
• Dark mode and 8 languages

No account, records on your device
There is no sign-up or login. Your entries, notes, photos and voice memos are stored on your device, with no cloud sync. From Settings you can back up and restore as JSON (photos not included) or export CSV.
To write its replies, the AI coach sends your recent emotion words, scores and times, tags, place, city and country names, any connected sleep, step and workout totals, and, for the weekly report, the name you entered, to our AI server. Your notes and photos are never sent. AI features are on by default and can be turned off in Settings. The app also uses Google Firebase Analytics for usage statistics, and the free version shows Google AdMob ads.

Free and Premium
Everything above is free, with no limit on entries. The free version shows ads, and AI guidance and action suggestions are limited to 10 per hour and 20 per day.
Premium removes ads, unlocks the weekly AI insight report and lifts the AI limits.

English, 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português (Brasil)

Support: https://moodient.raynear.xyz
